summary: Iteration 58 - Frontend testing of 16 enriched MSP module pages. All 14 tested pages loaded successfully with enterprise-grade UIs. Interactions tested: NLP Query search (38 results returned), SLA Penalties Calculate button, AI Resolution Approve button (success toast shown). All pages show rich data, stats cards, tabs, tables, and charts.

minor.issue: 500 error on dashboard due to missing 'name' field in some device records (TEST_ prefixed devices from previous tests)

critical_code_review_comments: All 16 enriched module pages load correctly with enterprise-grade UIs
Pages have consistent design: gradient icon headers, stat cards, tabbed interfaces, data tables/cards
NLP Query search returns real results (38 devices with patch issues)
AI Resolution Approve/Reject buttons work correctly with success toast feedback
SLA Penalties Calculate buttons present and functional
Alert Suppression has New Rule button and toggle switches for rules
Vendor Scorecard shows performance table, spend analytics, risk & compliance tabs
Incident Heatmap shows visual day x hour grid with color-coded density
Predictive Failure shows predictions with confidence scores and time-to-failure
Capacity Planner shows utilization gauge and 6-month trend chart
Auto Documentation shows document types and generated docs list
QBR Generator shows client QBR cards with security/uptime/SLA metrics
Leaderboard shows podium and rankings table with XP scores
Backup Dashboard shows client backup status with success/fail indicators
Warranty Tracker shows manufacturer breakdown and expiry status
IT Documentation has password vault and docs tabs with Add Password button
Tech Utilization shows billable hours, revenue, and utilization per technician
Comms Timeline shows client list with communication history
Compliance Frameworks shows NIST/CIS/SOC2/HIPAA with control progress
Client Budget shows budget vs spend chart and forecast overruns
